import os
import json
import select
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path


def snapshot(pid, cpus):
    start = time.monotonic_ns()
    root = Path('/proc') / str(pid)
    status = dict(line.split(':', 1) for line in (root / 'status').read_text().splitlines())
    stat = (root / 'stat').read_text().rsplit(')', 1)[1].split()
    sched = (root / 'schedstat').read_text().split()
    cpu_sched = {}
    for line in Path('/proc/schedstat').read_text().splitlines():
        row = line.split()
        if row[0] == 'version':
            assert row[1] == '17'
        if row[0] in [f'cpu{cpu}' for cpu in cpus]:
            assert len(row) == 10
            cpu_sched[row[0]] = dict(zip(['running_ns', 'waiting_ns', 'timeslices'], map(int, row[7:10])))
    cpu_ticks = {}
    for line in Path('/proc/stat').read_text().splitlines():
        row = line.split()
        if row[0] in cpu_sched:
            cpu_ticks[row[0]] = list(map(int, row[1:9]))
    return {
        'read_start_ns': start, 'read_end_ns': time.monotonic_ns(),
        'main_thread': {
            'voluntary_switches': int(status['voluntary_ctxt_switches']),
            'involuntary_switches': int(status['nonvoluntary_ctxt_switches']),
            'runtime_ns': int(sched[0]), 'runqueue_wait_ns': int(sched[1]),
            'timeslices': int(sched[2]), 'minor_faults': int(stat[7]),
            'major_faults': int(stat[9]), 'user_ticks': int(stat[11]),
            'system_ticks': int(stat[12]), 'last_cpu': int(stat[36]),
            'threads': int(status['Threads']),
        },
        'cpu_sched': cpu_sched, 'cpu_ticks': cpu_ticks,
    }


class PhaseObserver:
    def __init__(self, slot, executable, cpu):
        self.slot, self.executable, self.cpu = slot, executable.resolve(), cpu
        self.sibling = [int(v) for v in Path(f'/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu{cpu}/topology/thread_siblings_list').read_text().strip().split(',') if int(v) != cpu][0]
        self.directory = slot / 'observer'
        self.directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.records, self.errors = [], []
        self.ready = threading.Event()
        self.fds = []
        for file in [self.directory / 'control', self.directory / 'ack']:
            if not file.exists():
                os.mkfifo(file)
        for file in [self.directory / 'control', self.directory / 'ack', slot / 'control', slot / 'ack']:
            self.fds.append(os.open(file, os.O_RDWR))
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.relay, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()

    def attach(self, perf_pid):
        self.perf_pid = perf_pid
        self.ready.set()

    def benchmark_pid(self):
        todo = [self.perf_pid]
        while todo:
            pid = todo.pop()
            root = Path('/proc') / str(pid)
            if (root / 'exe').resolve() == self.executable:
                return pid
            todo.extend(map(int, (root / 'task' / str(pid) / 'children').read_text().split()))
        raise AssertionError('The benchmark must be a child of our perf process')

    def relay(self):
        try:
            # Keep the controller, perf parent and observer off the benchmark core.
            os.sched_setaffinity(0, {0})
            control = os.fdopen(os.dup(self.fds[0]), 'rb', buffering=0)
            with control:
                while (command := control.readline()) != b'stop\n':
                    assert command in [b'enable\n', b'disable\n'], command
                    self.ready.wait()
                    pid = self.benchmark_pid()
                    if command == b'disable\n':
                        record = snapshot(pid, [self.cpu, self.sibling])
                    os.write(self.fds[2], command)
                    assert select.select([self.fds[3]], [], [], 10)[0], 'perf acknowledgement timed out'
                    # perf writes the terminating NUL too; consume the complete message.
                    acknowledgement = os.read(self.fds[3], 256)
                    assert acknowledgement == b'ack\n\x00', acknowledgement
                    if command == b'enable\n':
                        record = snapshot(pid, [self.cpu, self.sibling])
                    self.records.append({'command': command.decode().strip(), 'pid': pid, 'snapshot': record})
                    os.write(self.fds[1], b'ack\n')
        except Exception as error:
            self.errors.append(repr(error))
            (self.directory / 'error.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.errors) + '\n')

    def close(self):
        os.write(self.fds[0], b'stop\n')
        self.thread.join(timeout=2)
        assert not self.thread.is_alive(), 'Observer relay did not finish'
        for fd in self.fds:
            os.close(fd)
        assert not self.errors, self.errors
        assert [r['command'] for r in self.records] == ['enable', 'disable']
        assert self.records[0]['pid'] == self.records[1]['pid']

import hashlib
import json
import mmap
import re
import struct
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

p = Path(__file__).parent
q = p
prior = p.parent / 'float-in-zero-case-f354c70'
selected = [json.loads((prior / 'code-comparison.json').read_text())['functions'][0]['name']]
records = [{'name': name} for name in selected]
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
for variant in ['before', 'after']:
    binary = q / f'{variant}-bench'
    symbols = subprocess.check_output(['nm', '-SC', '--defined-only', str(binary)], text=True)
    (p / f'{variant}-symbols.txt').write_text(symbols)
    rows = [row for line in symbols.splitlines() if len(row := line.split(maxsplit=3)) == 4]
    names = {int(row[0], 16): row[3] for row in rows if int(row[0], 16) != 0}
    with binary.open('rb') as file, mmap.mmap(file.fileno(), 0, access=mmap.ACCESS_READ) as elf:
        assert elf[:6] == b'\x7fELF\x02\x01'
        section_offset = struct.unpack_from('<Q', elf, 0x28)[0]
        section_size, section_count = struct.unpack_from('<HH', elf, 0x3a)
        relocations = {}
        for i in range(section_count):
            section = struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ', elf, section_offset + i * section_size)
            if section[1] != 4:  # SHT_RELA
                continue
            for at in range(section[4], section[4] + section[5], section[9]):
                address, info, addend = struct.unpack_from('<QQq', elf, at)
                if info & 0xffffffff == 8:  # R_X86_64_RELATIVE
                    relocations[address] = addend
        for n, record in enumerate(records):
            found = [row for row in rows if row[3] == record['name']]
            assert len(found) == 1
            start, size = [int(x, 16) for x in found[0][:2]]
            assembly = subprocess.check_output(['objdump', '-d', '-C', '--no-show-raw-insn', '-Mintel',
                                               f'--start-address={start}', f'--stop-address={start + size}', str(binary)], text=True)
            normalized, resolved = [], {}
            for line in assembly.splitlines():
                instruction = re.match(r'^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s+(.*)$', line)
                if not instruction:
                    continue
                op = instruction[2]
                slot = re.search(r'#\s+([0-9a-f]+) <_DYNAMIC[^>]*>', op)
                if slot:
                    target = relocations[int(slot[1], 16)]
                    name = names[target]
                    resolved[slot[1]] = {'target': hex(target), 'name': name}
                    op = op[:slot.start()] + '# <' + name + '>'
                op = re.sub(r'\[rip[+-]0x[0-9a-f]+\]', '[rip+relocation]', op)
                op = re.sub(r'\b[0-9a-f]+ <', '<', op)
                normalized.append(f'{int(instruction[1], 16) - start:04x} {op}')
            normalized = '\n'.join(normalized) + '\n'
            record[variant] = {'start': hex(start), 'size': size, 'alignment_mod64': start % 64,
                               'normalized_sha256': sha(normalized.encode()),
                               'instruction_count': len(normalized.splitlines()), 'resolved_slots': resolved,
                               'normalized': normalized, 'assembly': assembly}
            (p / f'code-{n}-{variant}.txt').write_text(assembly)
            (p / f'normalized-{n}-{variant}.txt').write_text(normalized)
for record in records:
    record['normalized_equal'] = record['before']['normalized'] == record['after']['normalized']
(p / 'code-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'method': 'Compare instruction offsets and operations, remove link addresses from named calls and RIP references, and resolve anonymous GOT slots using ELF R_X86_64_RELATIVE relocations and symbol names. This checks selected function bodies, not the entire executable or runtime data placement.',
    'functions': records,
}, indent=2) + '\n')
for record in records:
    print(record['before']['instruction_count'], 'instructions; equal:', record['normalized_equal'], record['name'][:140])
